scope: Source-only duplicate review of reserved20 groups/37 pairs versus old46 groups/89 development pairs, plus PVC handoff validation. No preference labels of confirmation data, edited images, model features, preference scoring, training, GPU, rentals, or Word writes.
allowed_confirmation_files: snapshot-03-confirmation-reserved/manifest.json and the source JPEGs referenced there only. Never read sealed_labels.json, future_rows_*.json, or raw confirmation metadata with winners.
exact_checks: File SHA256, RGB-only SHA256 (legacy group definition), and dimensions-plus-RGB SHA256. Check cross development and within reserved groups.
near_checks: 63-bit DCT pHash of full source and fixed centered80-percent crop,64-bit horizontal dHash of full source. Flag any full/crop pHash pair distance<=12 or full dHash<=10. These thresholds only select visual review cases and never automatically certify disjointness or exclude a source.
visual_review: Inspect all20 reserved originals with the nearest3 development candidates selected across full pHash,crop pHash,dHash. Inspect all threshold-flagged cross or within-reservation pairs. Record assistant visual source comparison explicitly, not independent human expert verification.
retention: Exact/same underlying photograph under crop/resize/recompression => exclude from future independent set. Distinct photograph with similar subject => keep only with explicit semantic-overlap note. Uncertain same-photo => quarantine. Do not replace excluded groups or change method here. Preserve original reservation snapshot; save new eligible index in this run.
PVC: Check existing32 diagnostic inputs and archive hashes, AB/BA candidate/label inversions, official argparse against generated commands, prompt asset path resolution, shell syntax and argument-only dry run. Do not load a judge or execute real inference. Record missing actual server/model/LoRA/environment paths as dependencies.
Word_taskbook: Frozen v1.3, no edit/copy/new version. All outcomes in this new local run and screened foreground-fidelity GitHub run only.
